# React Vite Frontend Starter Kit

> A production-ready frontend starter template built with React and Vite, featuring Tailwind CSS, React Router, dark mode, SEO essentials, and a scalable project structure.

Important notes:

- Built for modern frontend applications.
- Includes SEO best practices and developer tooling.
- Easy to extend for portfolios, business websites, dashboards, and SaaS applications.

## Project

- [Repository](https://github.com/ShankarDutta/react-vite-starter-kit): Source code and project files.
- [Author](https://github.com/ShankarDutta): GitHub profile.
- [Portfolio](https://shankarduttadev.vercel.app/): Personal portfolio and projects.

## Documentation

- [React](https://react.dev/): Official React documentation.
- [Vite](https://vite.dev/guide/): Official Vite guide.
- [React Router](https://reactrouter.com/): Client-side routing.
- [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/docs): Utility-first CSS framework.
- [ESLint](https://eslint.org/docs/latest/): JavaScript linting.
- [Prettier](https://prettier.io/docs/): Code formatting.

## Features

- React
- Vite
- React Router
- Tailwind CSS
- Dark & Light Theme
- SEO Metadata
- Open Graph Metadata
- Twitter Card Metadata
- Canonical URLs
- robots.txt
- sitemap.xml
- llms.txt
- ESLint
- Prettier
- Path Aliases
- 404 Not Found Page
